import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    while t > 0:
        t -= 1
        n = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        num = str(n)
        last_digit = int(num[-1])
        sum = 0
        sum += (last_digit - 1) * 10
        sum += len(num) * (len(num) + 1) // 2
        results.append(str(sum))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(results) + "\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
